ago.title: ago
ago.blurb: A semantic edit protocol for Go. Agents query the typechecked workspace and submit compiler-checked mutations instead of editing text.

autophage.title: autophage
autophage.blurb: Watches issues on enrolled GitHub repos and runs a sandboxed jess agent under a budget. Output is a PR or a request for approval.

jess.title: jess
jess.blurb: Streaming agent-loop runtime in Go. The leather strap on the falcon's leg.

rudy.title: rudy
rudy.blurb: Coding agent harness in Go. One binary: the model loop, tools, sessions, permissions and plugins, in a terminal, headless or as a server.
